contexts.text: For what is unconnected exists not; and what is unconnected perishes in a moment. AC 2886. HH 304:end.
There exists not anything unconnected with a cause, and thus with an end.
For everything which is unconnected with the Lord is nothing.
Everything unconnected with what is prior to itself, and through prior things with the First, perishes in an instant. AC 5084:3. AC 5116:3.
For without correspondence there would be... what is unconnected; and what is unconnected is dissipated as nothing.

Without correspondence with the Grand Man... nothing can ever exist and subsist, because it has no connection with what is prior to itself, consequently neither with the First... and what is unconnected, and thus independent, cannot subsist for a single moment...
When yet everything unconnected with the Divine perishes and becomes null.
For there is not anything in the natural world unconnected with the Spiritual World.
